title: Headcount sync - hiring & interview loop prep
body:
Context:
- Prep notes for weekly headcount sync (people-ops + eng leads). Focus: hiring velocity, interview loop health, debrief actions, req prioritization, blockers for offers.
- Meeting: Tue 2026-03-02 10:00 PT (30m) with Priya, Liam, Marta, engineering hiring managers.

Goals for sync:
- Quick snapshot of where we are vs plan (open reqs, offers, accept rate)
- Flag any interview loop risks (recruiter handoffs, interviewer bandwidth, rubric drift)
- Decide on top 3 reqs to accelerate this week (budgeted vs unbudgeted)
- Action items and owners for candidate closure / blocker removal

Current numbers (pipeline quick read, pulled 2026-02-28):
- Open reqs: 34 (engineering: 18, research: 3, infra/platform: 6, product/design: 7)
- Active candidates in pipeline: 112 (phone screen+)
- Offers extended (last 30d): 9, accepts: 6, declined: 2, pending: 1
- Average time to offer (phone screen -> offer): 25 days (target 21)
- Interview-to-offer conversion: 7% (need to improve)

Key risks / notes:
- Interviewer bandwidth: several senior ICs travel Mar 9-16 (impacting backend and infra loops).
- Interview rubric drift: feedback from hiring managers that SRE loop has become more conservative on perf questions - need recalibration.
- Candidate ghosting increases after take-home test in infra roles - consider replacing with pair-coding session.
- Offer speed: biggest blocker is compensation approval queue (finance sign-off). Need SLO.

Agenda (10:00 - 10:30)
- 10:00 quick numbers + highlights (2m) - Ava
- 10:02 pipeline outliers & urgent reqs (5m) - Priya
- 10:07 interview loop health & calibrations needed (6m) - Liam
- 10:13 offer velocity & finance blocker update (5m) - Marta
- 10:18 decisions: top 3 reqs to accelerate + immediate changes to loops (7m) - group
- 10:25 action items & owners (5m) - Ava

Decisions to propose (prep notes):
1) Accelerate offers for infra engineer req #ENG-927 (priority: reduce time-to-offer). Proposed: pre-approve comp range for top 2 bands to eliminate finance delay.
2) Replace take-home test in infra loop with 60m paired exercise with senior eng - expected to reduce ghosting and speed up signal. Pilot for 3 candidates.
3) Run a 30-minute rubric calibration session for SRE and infra interviewers next Wed 3/10 (in person + async doc). Mandatory for interviewers in loop.

Open questions to raise in sync:
- Can finance commit to 48-hour comp approvals for priority reqs? (needed to meet offer SLO)
- Which two senior ICs can be exempted from travel interview blackout to cover priority interviews?
- Approve pilot for pair-coding vs take-home for infra roles (duration, rubric, scoring).

Action items (owner - due):
- Priya: Share updated pipeline sheet with filter by stage + planned onsite dates (due 2026-03-03).
- Marta: Talk to finance and request 48-hour approval SLO for the 3 prioritized reqs; report back (due 2026-03-05).
- Liam: Draft pair-coding exercise and scoring rubric for infra pilot; include scoring template and interviewer notes (due 2026-03-04).
- Ava: Schedule rubric calibration meeting + create agenda and pre-read doc (due 2026-03-04).
- Hiring managers: Identify backup interviewers for travel blackout dates and confirm (due 2026-03-04).

Interview debrief template (to remind interviewers) - keep short:
- Candidate name / role / stage / date
- 3 strengths (bullet)
- 2 risks / concerns (bullet)
- Overall recommend: Strong Yes / Lean Yes / Borderline / Lean No / Strong No
- Must-have follow-ups (open questions)

Notes to self / follow-ups after sync:
- If finance cannot meet 48-hour SLO, escalate to VP of Finance with data (time-to-offer impact).
- Track effect of pair-coding pilot on ghosting and time-to-offer; measure conversion after 4 hires or 6 weeks.
- Add a recurring 15m hiring triage slot on Fridays for quick candidate unblock calls (trial for 4 weeks).

Quick links (for meeting):
- Hiring pipeline sheet: (internal)
- ENG-927 req details (JIRA)
- Past calibration notes: Confluence page link

Misc scratchpad items (may bring up if time):
- Consider temporary use of external agency for senior infra roles if pipeline doesn't produce X candidates in 10 days.
- Check referral bonus spend vs budget (possible reallocation).

Close: keep this doc as working notes - will copy final action items to the People-ops triage board and send meeting recap after sync.
